**Beta.** Multi-engine web search: queries several major
search engines in parallel, then merges and de-duplicates the results, ranking a
result higher when more engines agree on it. Bing, DuckDuckGo and Google are the
defaults; Bing and DuckDuckGo are the most reliable, Google is best-effort (if it is
captcha-blocked it lands in `engines_failed` and the call still succeeds on the
others). Each result carries its 1-based organic `rank`.

**Locale + rank:** set `region` (e.g. "India"/"Bangalore") and `lang` (e.g. "EN") to
localize the SERP, `engines:["google"]` for Google's own un-merged ranking, and
`target_domain` to get a `target` object with where your domain ranks. Locale is
approximate — our egress IPs are US/CA/GB, so `region` shifts results toward a locale
but is not IP-exact to a city (not a full substitute for local rank tracking, and a
live SERP will differ from Search Console average-position by nature). Set `deep=true`
to retrieve additional result pages. Ecosia is opt-in.

info.name: Ollagraph API
info.description:
Official Ollagraph API collection — 145 endpoints across fetch, extract,
audit, intelligence, and AEO/SEO families. Web infrastructure for AI agents.

Get started:
1. Sign up free at https://app.ollagraph.com (1,000 credits on signup, no card).
2. Copy your API key.
3. Set the {{api_key}} collection variable below.
4. Hit Send on any request.

Docs: https://ollagraph.com/docs/
Capabilities: https://ollagraph.com/capabilities
Support: support@ollagraph.com
